connection.instructions:
In **Employment Hero Payroll**, open **My Account → API key** and generate a key, then paste it below. The connector only reads payroll data.

If your key can see more than one payroll business, reports use the first one unless you choose a **Business ID** in the report (the number in your payroll URL, `…/business/123456/…`).

fields.name: EH_PAYROLL_API_KEY
fields.label: Payroll API key
fields.helpText: Employment Hero Payroll → My Account → API key. It carries your own payroll access.

description: Read-only Employment Hero Payroll (KeyPay, AU) reporting via the myHub-hosted MCP server: pay runs, gross to net, PAYG withholding (BAS W1/W2), super contributions, leave balances and payment summaries. Connect with your payroll API key.
name: employment-hero-payroll
